scope: Claude sealed discovery report and coordinator publication/adjudication; not native runtime acceptance or zero-bias ranking.
transformations: Replace the private projects-root prefix with <PROJECTS_ROOT> and private home prefix with <OPERATOR_HOME>; retain all claims, scores, source URLs, refutations and failures.
Append one final LF to the sealed compact JSON, which had none; apart from that and the two disclosed private-prefix substitutions, the public report is unchanged.
Do not publish raw workflow journals, transcripts or session identifiers. Usage uses stable child ordinals; exact raw inputs remain private.

workflow_counts.interpretation: Workflow-level zero errors excludes two earlier judge attempts without terminal journal results; retain both scopes.

usage_scope_correction: The handed-over child-usage-latest.txt describes the subsequently running WF3, not WF2. Public WF2 usage is re-derived with the exact WF2 directory, retaining missing terminal results and unknown tails.
boundary: Discovery uses broad grouped roles and a top-12-by-stars screen. Test/CI presence, native worker count, scores and refuter agreement do not prove comparative repository quality.
handoff_hash_scope: Return document observed at publication capture; the peer may append later WF3 material. The sealed compact report and first inventory are separately hashed.
